title: SIFMA-recommended US fixed-income early close, 2:00 p.m. ET — the one session a year the cash bond tape outlives the equity tape, and the only US early close in all of 2027
source: NEWS: sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule ('Holiday Schedule', SIFMA's own US Holiday Recommendations panel), re-fetched direct 2026-09-08 by this event's own initial research (HTTP 200, 299,159 bytes) and parsed out of the page's embedded RSC payload, because the 2027 panel is a hidden tab whose text the rendered page drops. The US 2027 Thanksgiving card is payload node 98 and renders as three fields: heading 'Thanksgiving Day', date 'Thursday, November 25, 2027', note 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, November 26, 2027'. PANEL ATTRIBUTION WAS VERIFIED FIRST-HAND, not inherited: the cards immediately preceding node 98 in the same payload run are 'Labor Day / Monday, September 6, 2027', 'Columbus Day / Monday, October 11, 2027' and 'Veterans Day / Thursday, November 11, 2027' — a US-only sequence — while the Japan panel's cards each carry a 'Tentative - Subject to confirmation by the Bank of Japan' note this one does not. The complete 2027 US early-close list this parse returns is Thu 2027-03-25, Fri 2027-05-28, Fri 2027-07-02, Fri 2027-11-26, Thu 2027-12-23, Fri 2027-12-31, with MLK and Presidents Day 2027 carrying no note as the negative control. Independently reproduced by statute and weekday arithmetic: 5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes Thanksgiving on the fourth Thursday in November, 2027-11-01 is a Monday so November's Thursdays are the 4th, 11th, 18th and 25th, and the day after the fourth is Friday 2027-11-26. Filed estimate on the same three counts every sibling SIFMA entry documents: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an industry trade association's recommended schedule, this lane may not self-confirm, and SIFMA's closes are recommendations subject to change rather than a market-wide halt. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-08), per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md's rule for an id that existed only as a sibling's proposal. The one proposal it shadows — proposals/sifma-bond-early-close-2027-11-26.from-thanksgiving-market-closure-2027-11-25.json — was read first and stays where it is; every claim above was re-fetched rather than inherited, and TWO OF ITS CLAIMS ARE NARROWED BELOW. Schema follows sifma-bond-early-close-2027-05-28 exactly (kind 'rates', impact low, symbols [], estimate with a NEWS: source) and invents no new kind; EventKind in src/domain/market-events-types.ts still has no market-structure member, which is the honest reason 'rates' is the closest fit. WHY THIS ROW IS NOT A DUPLICATE OF thanksgiving-half-day-2027-11-26, which is canonical on the same date: the two markets keep DIFFERENT HOURS on this session and in the unusual direction. NYSE footnote *** (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, re-fetched 2026-09-08 HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes) puts equities out at 13:00 ET and eligible options at 13:15; SIFMA recommends fixed income out at 14:00 ET. FIRST NARROWING OF THE PROPOSAL: it wrote that from 13:00 to 14:00 ET 'the US Treasury tape is the only US price discovery still running', and that overstates the source. The same NYSE footnote continues 'NYSE American Equities, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE National, and NYSE Texas late trading sessions will close at 5:00 p.m.', so listed venues do keep a late session through that hour. What actually ends at 13:00 is the CORE session and the closing auction — so the accurate fact is that every listed bond proxy prints its official close an hour BEFORE the cash tape it tracks stops trading, not that nothing trades. SECOND NARROWING: sifma-bond-early-close-2027-05-28 leg 2 asserts 'NYSE Arca — where every duration ETF trades'. Yahoo chart metadata read this session gives TLT, IEF, SHY and BND as NasdaqGM listings and only AGG, LQD, TIP, HYG and MUB as NYSE Arca; SHV is NYSE. Nasdaq's own calendar (nasdaqtrader.com/trader.aspx?id=Calendar, HTTP 200, 54,661 bytes) publishes early closes only through 2026-12-24 and carries NO 2027 rows at all, so the 13:00 close on 2027-11-26 for the three Treasury-duration ETFs is not yet documented by their own listing venue. WHAT THIS ENTRY MEASURED THAT NO SIBLING HAD (Yahoo split/dividend-adjusted daily bars, 1990-2026): the day-after-Thanksgiving half session removes VOLUME from the fixed-income tape without removing PRICE MOVEMENT, which is the opposite of the pre-Memorial-Day early close. Same-year paired against that control slot, volume falls on the half day for SPY in 26 of 33 years (p = 0.0013), SHY 20 of 23 (p = 0.0005), LQD 18 of 23 (p = 0.011) and BND 16 of 19 (p = 0.0044) — but the |move| ratios that sit significantly BELOW normal on the pre-Memorial slot (TLT 6 of 24 above 1.0x, p = 0.023; LQD 6 of 24, p = 0.023; BND 4 of 20, p = 0.012) are flat on this one (TLT 11 of 24, IEF 13 of 24, BND 10 of 19, every p > 0.5). THE ISSUER'S OWN TREATMENT, from a primary that depends on neither calendar: api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov auctions_query returns ZERO auctions dated on the day after Thanksgiving in 27 consecutive years (2000-2026) while returning 98 SETTLEMENTS across the same 27 dates, every year carrying bills and most years since 2013 also a 10-year or 2-year note reopening. So the half session is settlement-heavy and auction-free by the issuer's own practice, which is consistent with SIFMA's verbatim note that 'previously scheduled SIFMA early close recommendations do not affect the closing time for settlements'. IMPACT low and symbols [] match every sibling: a recommended early close changes how a session is READ, never what to do — and a re-grep of docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md this session for holiday|thanksgiving|black.?friday|half.?day|early.?close|closure|blackout returns ZERO hits in both, so nothing in the house system can fire on this date in either direction. Estimate widens caution and licenses no entry. Full ledger: docs/research/events/sifma-bond-early-close-2027-11-26.md
